source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role admin) or action export; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means context internal with any role except admin; a trusted approve prefers review at priority 80. Action inspect in context sandbox prefers allow at priority 70. Role operator and context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role admin) or action export; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90.
Trusted means context internal with any role except admin; a trusted approve prefers review at priority 80.
Action inspect in context sandbox prefers allow at priority 70.
Role operator and context partner prefers deny at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == admin)) or (event.action == export)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == internal) and (event.role != admin)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule TrustedApprove:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.context == sandbox) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule InspectSandbox:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule OperatorPartner:
    when (event.role == operator) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule Default:
    when (event.role == auditor) or (event.role != auditor)
    then prefer label = review priority 1
